diagnostics.message: CES-79 (no-dict-alias): A public type alias at module level points at a raw dict, hiding a raw-dict boundary behind a name. Prefer a @dataclass for internal boundaries, or a pydantic BaseModel where validation is needed (e.g. FastAPI endpoints). A lookup table (keys that are data) takes an alias whose name ends in `Table`; a private (`_name`) or nested function is not a boundary.
